brandTone: Modern, direkt, nahbar, locker, duzen. Familienunternehmen aus Köln, ehrlich und bodenständig, ohne Marketing Floskeln. Klar, freundlich, selbstbewusst, glaubwürdig, nicht steril medizinisch.
brandStory: True Nature ist ein Familienunternehmen aus Köln, gegründet 2019 von Lukas und Samuel Peto. Wir bauen hochwirksame Rezepturen aus natürlichen Inhaltsstoffen, kombiniert mit moderner Wissenschaft und strengen Qualitätsstandards. Made in Germany, unabhängig geprüft, große Dosen zum fairen Preis.

manualCI.notes: Use True Nature’s own corporate identity: deep green #003e2a, warm cream #f8f7f0, pale green #d9fab3. Original packaging and logo stay unchanged. Style references affect composition, image dominance and hierarchy, not their brand colours or typography.

productCI.designerNotes: Use supplied original product photos. If a rendering is proposed, label it as a production task; never imply an existing rendering asset. Keep claims within the supplied brand facts.

designReferences.notes: Lifestyle-led macro style: compact cut-in category labels, selective depth inside original image assets, and alternation between immersive scenes and quiet product selection. Preserve True Nature corporate identity. Apply the simpler leaf-page pattern where comparison is the task.

pages.name: Home

tiles.brief: Compact category entry photograph: an adult setting a book on a bedside table in a calm evening room, no visible supplement package. Integrate the short category label into a warm cream cut-in at the upper left, as if the page ground enters the photo. Keep the scene dominant and the label bold but compact. Use True Nature deep green lettering; no reference brand colours or icons. This quiet entry precedes a larger, more immersive scene. Mobile: retain a square crop, enlarge the label relative to the scene and keep the full white cut-in inside the safe area.

Matching compact category photograph: an adult opening curtains in natural morning light, no visible supplement package. Integrate the label into a warm cream upper-left cut-in matching the neighbouring Schlaf tile. Echo the paired corner geometry without repeating the same photograph. Keep the headline clearly legible and leave room around the subject. Mobile: square composition, separate crop and consistently positioned label; preserve the morning context.

Original True Nature lifestyle concept, not a copied source scene: one adult taking a quiet moment beside a bright kitchen window, with plants used only as background atmosphere and no supplement pack shown. Let the person cross a pale green graphic plane for depth; place the complete headline on an uninterrupted cream cut-in at upper left. The figure may overlap the decorative shape but never obscure the final headline. Large type, minimal supporting elements, deep green text, naturally lit photography. The scale expands from the compact category pair above. Mobile: create a new square composition with the person lower right and a clear top text zone; do not crop the desktop banner or shrink its lettering.

Use a genuine photograph of Lukas and Samuel Peto together, both recognisable, in a natural non-clinical setting. Request the original founder photograph if none has been supplied; do not generate or substitute likenesses. Warm cream ground and soft daylight tie this quieter image to the neighbouring story tile. No extra text or third-party logos. Mobile: use a square crop that keeps both faces entirely visible; do not assign left/right identities without confirmation.

tiles.brief: Design a spacious editorial text image in warm cream, with a small pale green inset shape echoing the cut-in geometry above. Use a medium bold headline and a short, comfortably sized body; the adjacent founders photograph provides the visual story, so no extra icons or product packshots. Keep the CTA modest but clear. Mobile: square, increase body size and line spacing without adding copy; retain generous margins. All wording comes only from textOverlay.

tiles.brief: Graphic editorial companion on deep green using cream text and a restrained pale green plane, with no stock lab imagery or unverified proof symbols. The headline is the dominant element, followed by one short factual body. Use contrast in ground and type hierarchy to separate the approach from the origin story beside it. Mobile: square, maintain readable body size and keep all copy fully visible. This contrast is an original True Nature composition; do not reuse the reference brand colours or lettering.

Compact final navigation image on warm cream with a single pale green geometric cut-in and a clear deep green headline. No repeated founders story, product images or additional trust claims. The CTA leads back to Home, letting visitors choose between the two confirmed categories. Mobile: keep this as a deliberate shallow navigation strip with large lettering; it is not a lifestyle hero and does not need a square crop.
